## f4d60fd96dde

**Reproduced shortcut.** Generator SHA-256
`9378680b542f409d8ab974101d14e181ad47bf571c88add735e71c3c4574de3d`
(`2.0.1`, rule hash `43946341d62f`) constructs eroded monochrome rectangles. The
wrong rule **“for each same-color connected component, fill its bounding rectangle”**
matches **4/4 canonical pairs**, **600/600 generated draws** (200 per band; 600 unique
inputs), and **64/64 direct Racket-scored generated inputs**. It is therefore a perfect
shortcut on the sampled teaching support.

A concrete 4×4 input accepted by the target `self_check` separates the rules. The
canonical single-pass rule fills only the local missing corner, while the rival fills an
entire 3×3 rectangle. Supported Racket output, rival output, input, hashes, and command
are retained in `checks/audit/f4d60fd96dde/`; the 600-draw source-bound census and limits
are in `rival.json`. This is audit-only; I did not edit the target.
